description.narrative: Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (AHB or the Company) is a leading manufacturer of amino acids and other bio-based products in the Peoples Republic of China (PRC). IFC is proposing to provide up to RMB 500 million (equivalent to US$70.5 million) in the form of a Green Loan (the Loan) to Qinhuangdao Huaheng Bioengineering Co., Ltd. (QHB), a wholly-owned subsidiary of AHB. The IFC proceeds will be used to fund the capex and working capital needs of malic acid and L-Tryptophan production (the Project).

The most significant, expected Project-level outcomes are: (i) environmental effects through greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reduction through lower-emission manufacturing processes; and (ii) economywide effects through value addition, exports and job creations. Furthermore, the Project is expected to contribute to market creation through promoting product complexity and the shift towards more sophisticated manufacturing capabilities in China, with potential to replicate in other emerging markets.
